name: Muesello's Best Summoning Rune

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #3-11: No Time for Treason

disable: DC 23 Acrobatics check to approach without triggering the trap followed by DC 25 Thievery check (expert) to erase the rune, or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 22) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

items.name: Summon Monster
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the cloud of magical sensors.

---

Effect This trap summons a Living Landslide (PFS 3-11) with the elite adjustment. The living landside rolls initiative and remains for 7 rounds, after which the spell ends and the living landside disappears. The living landside also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires. The summoned living landside can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

text: A cloud of invisible magical sensors in a 5-foot radius surrounds an invisible wall or floor rune the size of the creature to be summoned.
